name: gizza-ai/ics-agenda-view
summary: Turn an iCalendar .ics file into a day-by-day agenda with free-gap detection.

tool.description: Parse pasted iCalendar (.ics) text into a deterministic agenda grouped by day. Converts UTC, floating, all-day and recognized TZID event times into a chosen display timezone; unfolds folded lines; unescapes text fields; expands a bounded RRULE subset with EXDATE; hides cancelled events by default; and finds free gaps inside a configurable daily working window. Output as plain text, Markdown or JSON. Runs locally with no calendar account, URL fetch or network access.

day_end.description: End of the daily free-gap search window in 24-hour HH:MM time. Must be after day_start; 24:00 is accepted. Default 18:00.

day_start.description: Start of the daily free-gap search window in 24-hour HH:MM time. Default 09:00.

days.description: Number of days to render, from 1 to 90. Default 7.

details.description: How much event detail to show. compact prints times and summaries; normal adds location and recurrence/cancelled markers; full also includes organizer, UID, status, and a truncated description.

expand_recurring.description: Expand supported RRULEs (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly with interval/count/until/byday/bymonthday) inside the selected window. Turn off to list each recurring series only once. Default true.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter. Matches event summary, location, description, organizer, UID, and status before the agenda is rendered. Leave blank for all events.

ics.description: The full iCalendar text to parse, including BEGIN:VCALENDAR and one or more VEVENT entries. Supports LF or CRLF line endings, folded lines, TEXT escaping, DTSTART/DTEND/DURATION, all-day events, TZID parameters, EXDATE, and a bounded RRULE subset. Up to 1 MiB.

include_cancelled.description: Include VEVENT entries whose STATUS is CANCELLED. Default false.

min_gap_minutes.description: Only show free gaps at least this many minutes long, from 5 to 480. Default 30.

output.description: Output format. text is an aligned agenda, markdown is a notes-friendly heading/list format, and json returns days, events, gaps, totals, and warnings.

show_gaps.description: Show free gaps between meetings inside the day_start/day_end window and include empty days. Turn off for a compact agenda with events only. Default true.

start_date.description: Optional agenda start date as YYYY-MM-DD in the display timezone. Leave blank to start at the earliest event date after recurrence expansion.

timezone.description: Display timezone as an IANA name such as UTC, Europe/Berlin, or America/New_York. Floating and all-day event times are interpreted in this zone; UTC and recognized TZID event times are converted into it.
